title: Cranberry Orange Muffins

items: ¼ cup orange juice (squeezed from 2 oranges)
2-3 Tbsp coarse grained sugar (such as Sugar in the Raw)

steps: Preheat the oven to 375F (no convection) and line the muffin pan with liners.
Toss the cranberries in flour to coat and set aside.
Sift together the remaining flour, salt, and baking powder and set aside.
Combine the orange juice and yogurt and set aside.
Cream the butter, orange zest, and 1 cup sugar on medium (Kitchenaid speed 4) until light.
Add the eggs and vanilla, beating to incorporate well.
Add a third of the flour, then a third of the orange+yogurt mixture, mixing well between additions.  Repeat until all of the flour and liquids are incorporated.
Fold in the cranberries into the batter.
Distribute the batter into the muffin liners then gently tap the tray on a hard surface to level the batter and remove large air bubbles.
Sprinkle a large pinch of sugar over the top of each muffin.
Bake for 30 minutes at 375 F, non-convection.
Remove the muffins from the baking pan immediately to cool on a wire rack for 5-10 minutes.
sourceNote: Adapted from Jordan Marsh’s Blueberry Muffin recipe, https://sallysbakingaddiction.com/cranberry-orange-muffins/
